intuition: Every group must begin at the smallest card still remaining, and its consecutive values must have enough copies.

brute_force.approach: Try possible groups recursively and backtrack over which cards they consume.

optimal.approach: Count cards and process distinct starting values from a min-heap, subtracting each required consecutive group.

edge_cases: The hand size must be divisible by the group size.
Repeated card values are consumed according to their multiplicity.
